study: retrospective controlled rigid-registration recovery using frozen PFAD outputs
inputs: all frozen query candidates; no CT-derived visibility or ROI filtering
selection: random/geometric controls match PFAD retained count separately within every record; all selected controls use the same frozen bounded correction
registration_target: complete requested-anatomy CT mesh, available only to downstream registration/evaluation after selection is frozen
level_units: rotation magnitude degrees around a random unit axis
translation magnitude mm in a random unit direction
primary_aggregation: exclude aligned-start diagnostic; average starts and levels within each case, anatomies within each specimen, then report 14 paired specimen values
solver: Open3D multiscale point-to-plane ICP with Huber loss, fixed for all methods
success_criterion: translation error <4 mm AND rotation error <5 degrees; computational benchmark threshold, not clinical acceptability
reference_basis: known imposed transform composed with the released CT-US alignment; no independent surgical fiducials were found
reference_prior_art: https://github.com/luohwu/NeuralBoneReg-implementation (uses UltraBones100k and synthetic rigid perturbation; our local-initialization protocol is distinct and results will not be compared across protocols)
statistics: 100000 specimen bootstrap resamples; paired two-sided Wilcoxon; Holm across 3 baseline comparisons times 2 primary endpoints
